description: Pause for ms milliseconds (clamped to 60000). Prefer electron_wait_for_state or electron_wait_for_selector — a fixed wait is slower and more brittle than waiting on a condition. Returns: { ok, session_id, waited_ms }. Errors: NOT_RUNNING (no session), BAD_ARGUMENT (multiple sessions).

ms.description: Milliseconds to wait (clamped to the max).

sessionId.description: Target session id. Omit when a single session is running.

name: electron_wait
title: Wait a fixed duration
